name: Weather Display
description: Look up current weather by city from the app's own store of weather reports
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may look up weather and read recent lookups; require auth for creating, updating and deleting weather reports; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Data source: the app serves weather only from its own store of reports and calls no outside service; on first start the store holds sample reports for at least five cities (for example London, Paris, Tokyo, New York and Sydney)
A report holds the current conditions of one city; city names are unique ignoring case (a second report for the same city answers 409)

Report validation: city is a required non-empty string of at most 100 characters; country, when given, is at most 100 characters; temperature_c is a number from -90 to 60; condition is one of sunny, cloudy, rain, snow, storm, fog; humidity, when given, is a whole number 0-100; wind_kph, when given, is a number from 0 to 500
observed_at is set by the server whenever a report is created or replaced; temperatures are stored and returned in degrees Celsius

GET /api/weather returns active reports ordered by city name; ?city= keeps only the report whose city equals the given name ignoring case and surrounding spaces (an empty list when there is none), ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching report

Every request to GET /api/weather with ?city= is recorded as a lookup of the name as typed, with found true or false; GET /api/weather/recent returns lookups newest first, ?limit= caps how many are returned (default 10, at most 50), and total counts every stored lookup
Deactivated reports (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/weather, are not found by lookups and answer 404 on GET /api/weather/:id; the admin overview still lists them
DELETE /api/weather/:id removes a report permanently; any signed-in user may create, replace and delete any report
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for a duplicate city
frontend_requirements: Everyone gets the city search and the recent lookups read-only; signed-in users also get the add, edit and delete controls for reports, and visitors see a 'Sign in to manage reports' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out

City search: an input with a 'Search' button that asks GET /api/weather with ?city=; show a weather card with city, country, temperature, condition, humidity, wind and the observed time, or a 'No weather data for <city>' message when nothing matches
A Celsius/Fahrenheit switch converts the shown temperatures in the browser (F = C * 9 / 5 + 32); the API is always asked for Celsius
Recent lookups: the five newest lookups (?limit=5), each showing the city as typed and whether it was found; clicking one repeats the search
Show a loading state while a request runs and the API's error message when one fails
Report management for signed-in users: a list of all reports with add and edit forms that show the API's validation messages, and delete after a confirmation
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every report, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a report's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: Active weather reports by city name, optionally narrowed to one city

query.city: City name matched exactly, ignoring case and surrounding spaces; records a lookup

api_endpoints.description: Add a weather report for a city

query.limit: How many lookups to return (default 10, at most 50)

api_endpoints.description: Replace a report's fields (city, temperature_c and condition required; an omitted country, humidity or wind_kph is cleared)

data_models.name: WeatherReport
data_models.description: The current conditions of one city, kept in the app's own store

fields.city: string (required, max 100 chars, unique ignoring case)
fields.condition: string (one of: sunny, cloudy, rain, snow, storm, fog)
fields.observed_at: datetime (set by the server on create and replace, ISO 8601 in JSON)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the report from public endpoints and lookups)

data_models.name: Lookup
data_models.description: One city search made through GET /api/weather with ?city=

fields.city: string (the name as typed, max 100 chars)
fields.report_id: integer (optional, references WeatherReport.id; cleared when the report is deleted)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every report with counts
